title: Compute fields and calculate totals live
description: Automatically compute field values, totals, and balances with server-side guarantees and instant Admin UI reactivity.
problem: You want multi-field calculations (like price totals and remaining balances) to calculate live in the Admin UI while guaranteeing consistency in the database.
summary: Use beforeChange for server-side persistence guarantees combined with admin.hooks.onChange for instant live reactivity as editors type.
runtimeNotes: Uses beforeChange for database guarantees and admin.hooks.onChange for live Admin UI reactivity.
intents: calculate order totals from sibling inputs
update field values live as an editor types
guarantee computed values in the database
